fix_subject: Handle invalid rows and failing member casts in TRY_CAST from STRUCT to UNION
pr_title: Merge #26600: Handle invalid rows and failing member casts in TRY_CAST from STRUCT to UNION

labels.summary: STRUCT to UNION casts ignored failing member-cast results and threw ConversionException even under TRY_CAST for invalid union rows, surfacing as an internal error; invalid rows now go through the cast error handling so TRY_CAST yields NULL.
